    "Some limitations in advanced inventory management features for a retail setting",
    "Occasional frustration with customer support response times"

  "overall_experience": "This owner of a small retail business found Xero to be a generally positive change after switching from MYOB Business. They appreciated the modern, cloud-based interface and the efficiency it brought to managing their finances, particularly with bank reconciliation. While facing a minor learning curve and some specific retail functionality gaps, the overall ease of use and improved financial oversight made it a worthwhile transition."
